speaker: barnaby_yaxley
text: Sit by the window, sir. The light is kinder to a villain than a candle is. Open.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The cloves have stopped answering. The left side of my face has belonged to someone else since the night before last.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The left. Chewing has been the right side's work since the ninth of September.

speaker: barnaby_yaxley
text: Lay your head back. Hm.

speaker: barnaby_yaxley
text: There's your villain. Lower left, and he's dug himself a cellar. The gum's proud. That's matter gathering.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Can you draw it this morning? I have the hour, and I am not in the shrew.

speaker: barnaby_yaxley
text: Not with the swelling so hot. I will not pull a tooth out of a fire. A hot bran poultice, two nights. Salt water. Then Tuesday, at ten.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tuesday at ten. I am not cast that day. I can take the hour.

speaker: barnaby_yaxley
text: Twelve pence, and you'll thank me after. Nobody thanks me during.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twelve pence. I will not pay it this morning for a tooth that is still in my head.

speaker: barnaby_yaxley
text: I do not want it this morning. I want it when the villain is on the tray. Bring the twelve then. Do not bring a speech.

speaker: barnaby_yaxley
text: September. A month of cloves is a cellar with a roof on it. I am pricing the roof, not your patience.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Could it wait till Lent?

speaker: barnaby_yaxley
text: It could. You couldn't.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is a short argument. I think you have won it.

speaker: barnaby_yaxley
text: Bran, hot, two nights. Salt in the morning and at night. Tuesday, ten of the clock. Twelve pence. You may hum. You may not move the hour.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two nights, then. I can count two. The weeks did not draw it, and I am done asking them to.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not moving it. The company can play without me on Tuesday afternoon. They are managing a day without me today.

speaker: barnaby_yaxley
text: The company is not my patient. You are. Ten. Do not eat a crust to prove a point.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No crust. I am going up to the Theatre to tell them the hour. I am not staying to be in the shrew. The bran is tonight.

speaker: barnaby_yaxley
text: Hear them, then. A proud gum makes a deeper cellar if you shout on it. Saturday is not the day I named. Tuesday is.

speaker: barnaby_yaxley
text: And not a third night because the second felt almost civil. Salt. No crust. Tuesday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tuesday. Ten. Twelve pence. I will thank you after, as you require, and not a minute before.

speaker: barnaby_yaxley
text: After, sir. Not before. Close. The looking is finished.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Closed. Two nights, Tuesday, and the twelve with the tooth. I am taking no speech up the street with me.
